sentence: This project builds mathematical tools that connect descriptions of moving particles at three scales.
This project builds a self-learning robotic method to make superconducting quantum circuits and thin films.
This project studies the water quality and the organisms living in the canals of Bangkok, using paper sensors and DNA sequencing.
This project studies how AI systems can act and work together in the physical world, using optimization.
This project builds computational tools that speed up the analysis of proteins measured with mass spectrometry machines.
This project builds sensors and methods that help drones work out their position in space while using little power.
This project builds a way for teams of robots to work together on mobile manipulation in hard, unknown places.
This project holds a meeting where scientists share what they know about maize genetics.
This project studies how special hybrid light-matter waves carry energy through very thin materials and change how light-detecting devices work.
This project builds computers from noisy magnetic devices that work with probability, to run machine learning using less energy.
This project studies how tile drainage in agricultural land changes streamflow and water temperature in the upper Midwest.
This project studies whether fast computer methods exist for questions about knots and shapes, including methods that need a quantum computer.
This project builds an AI tutoring system that gives step-by-step help and practice exercises for coding in Java.
This project studies how wildfire smoke chemicals build up on indoor surfaces, change over time, and expose people.
This project builds a digital twin of an electromagnetic sensor on a chip to test designs instead of physical sensors.
This project builds three laboratories for coding, robotics and artificial intelligence to support technician education.
This project studies how thylakoid membranes inside the chloroplasts of green algae form and organize themselves.
This project builds a system that learns from human experts how to run symbolic execution faster to find software vulnerabilities.
